topic: Tilt of Earth's Axis and Daytime Length
key_concepts: Earth's axis is tilted by 23.5 degrees
Earth's axis is imaginary and not perpendicular
Earth's rotation on its axis causes daytime and nighttime
Earth's revolution around the Sun affects how sunlight reaches each hemisphere
When the North Pole tilts toward the Sun, the Northern Hemisphere has longer daytime
Longer daytime allows the ground to absorb more energy and leads to summer
When a hemisphere tilts away from the Sun, nighttime is longer and winter occurs
Direct rays hit Earth at a 90-degree angle and produce warmer areas
Indirect rays hit Earth at an angle and produce cooler areas
The equator receives direct rays and is generally warm
The poles receive indirect rays and are generally cold
Length of daytime changes throughout the year at a given place
